{{Quote|Honored Agent. The Dark Council learned of your predicament and send us to join you. We regret that we were detained.|Ilikith|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Ilikith''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was sent alongside Lord [[Charnoq (Sith Lord)|Charnoq]] to recovered the [[Black Codex]] from the [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]] on the [[Star Chamber (space station)|Star Chamber]] in [[Null Zone/Legends|Null Zone]].

==Behind the scenes==
If the player decides to destroy the Codex, Illikith and Charnoq attack the player. If the player sided with [[Darth Jadus]] in Act 1, Ilikith identified them as Hand of Darth Jadus. If the player spares [[Ardun Kothe]] on [[Quesh]] and later joins him on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Illikith and Charnoq are killed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
